name: Casas de Garcimolina (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casas de Garcimolina (a castle and a boar on red and white).
history: Municipal flag of Casas de Garcimolina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casas de Garcimolina arms — castle and boar
